channel.description: Latest updates to ChatGPT and Codex.

item.title: GPT-5.5 retirement in Codex
item.content:encoded:
# GPT-5.5 retirement in Codex
Effective October 14, 2026, at noon PDT (19:00 UTC), GPT-5.5 retires from Codex for users signed in with ChatGPT. The OpenAI API and Codex sessions authenticated with an API key aren't affected.
Use **GPT-6.1 Sol** (`gpt-6.1-sol`) when available to your plan and client. Update workspace defaults, saved model settings, managed configurations, custom agents, scheduled tasks, and scripts that still select `gpt-5.5`.
See [GPT-5.5 retirement](/codex/models#gpt-55-retirement) for plan-specific replacements and [workspace model availability](/codex/enterprise/workspace-model-availability#prepare-for-the-gpt-55-retirement) for administrator guidance.

item.title: Composer predictions in Codex
item.content:encoded:
# Composer predictions in Codex
Composer predictions adds autocomplete-style suggestions for your next message in the Codex desktop app. After Codex responds, it uses the current conversation to suggest a follow-up prompt in the message box. Press **Tab** to accept the suggestion as an editable draft, or type your own message. Accepting a prediction doesn't send it for you.
The feature is available in beta to users aged 18 and older with personal ChatGPT Pro plans in supported regions, in local and SSH threads with GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol.
Learn more about [composer predictions](/codex/features/composer-predictions).

item.title: Codex app
item.content:encoded:
# Codex app
### Performance improvements and bug fixes
- Fixed queued messages getting stuck on **Sending** and restored **Steer** in secondary app windows. - Improved scrolling and navigation between files in the **Changes** panel. - Added clearer recovery guidance when a tool call needs approval but the chat's permissions prevent approval requests, with a link to those permissions when available.

item.title: ChatGPT for iOS
item.content:encoded:
# ChatGPT for iOS
### New features
- Added an optional Face ID or passcode lock for Codex. - Added a new settings screen for choosing Queue or Steer as the default follow-up behavior and toggling line wrapping for code diffs. - Added support for connecting to Windows machines over SSH.
### Improvements and bug fixes
- Added support for `/side <prompt>` to start a side conversation with an initial question. - Improved follow-up prompts, the Codex home screen, and viewing changed files. - Fixed issues with reconnecting, archiving threads, loading tasks, and connecting to hosts.
